using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using Moq.Protected;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic;
using OpenRA.Primitives;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Widgets.Logic.Installation
{
	public class DownloadPackageLogicTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public async Task MirrorListDownload_SuccessfullyFetchesAndSelectsRandomMirror()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			var download = new ModContent.ModDownload
			{
				MirrorList = "http://example.com/mirrors.txt",
				URL = "http://fallback.com/package.zip"
			};

			var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			mockHttpClient.Protected()
				.Setup<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>("SendAsync", ItExpr.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
				.ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Content = new StringContent("http://mirror1.com/package.zip\nhttp://mirror2.com/package.zip")
				});

			var httpClientFactoryMock = new Mock<Func<HttpClient>>();
			httpClientFactoryMock.Setup(f => f()).Returns(mockHttpClient.Object);

			// Replace HttpClientFactory.Create with our mock (integration-style test)
			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockHttpClient.Object;

			var onSuccessCalled = false;
			var logic = new DownloadPackageLogic(null!, modData, download, () => onSuccessCalled = true);

			// Act
			await Task.Delay(100); // Allow Task.Run to execute

			// Assert
			mockHttpClient.Verify(c => c.GetAsync("http://example.com/mirrors.txt", It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
			Assert.True(onSuccessCalled);

			HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task MirrorListDownload_FailsBackToPrimaryUrl_OnHttpError()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			var download = new ModContent.ModDownload
			{
				MirrorList = "http://example.com/mirrors.txt",
				URL = "http://fallback.com/package.zip"
			};

			var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			mockHttpClient.Protected()
				.Setup<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>("SendAsync", ItExpr.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
				.ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.NotFound));

			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockHttpClient.Object;

			var logic = new DownloadPackageLogic(null!, modData, download, () => { });

			// Act
			await Task.Delay(100);

			// Assert - should log error and call DownloadUrl with primary URL
			mockHttpClient.Verify(c => c.GetAsync("http://example.com/mirrors.txt", It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void MirrorListDownload_UsesPrimaryUrl_WhenNoMirrorList()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			var download = new ModContent.ModDownload
			{
				URL = "http://direct.com/package.zip"
			};

			var logic = new DownloadPackageLogic(null!, modData, download, () => { });

			// Act & Assert - directly calls DownloadUrl without mirror fetching
			Assert.NotNull(logic);
		}
	}
}
